acip: 'DOD PAS LOG PAR G-YEM PA BRNAB SEMS MA BYIN LEN GSUM 'DOD CHAGS KYIS NI RDZOGS PAR BYED, LOG PAR LTA BA GTI MUG GIS RDZOGS PAR BYED DE, CHER RMONGS PA LAS LOG LTA 'BYUNG BA'I PHYIR,
wylie: 'dod pas log par g-yem pa brnab sems ma byin len gsum 'dod chags kyis ni rdzogs par byed, log par lta ba gti mug gis rdzogs par byed de, cher rmongs pa las log lta 'byung ba'i phyir
english: Another three--the non-virtues of sexual misconduct, coveting, and stealing--are brought to completion by desire. Mistaken views are brought to completion by an ignorance of things, for mistaken views spring from a deep-seated lack of understanding.

acip: LHAG MA RDZUN PHRA MA NGAG KYAL GSUM DUG GSUM GYIS RDZOGS PAR 'DOD DE, 'DOD CHAGS KYIS KUN NAS BSLANGS PA 'DOD CHAGS KYIS RDZOGS PAR BYED PA LTA BU'O, ,
wylie: lhag ma rdzun phra ma ngag kyal gsum dug gsum gyis rdzogs par 'dod de, 'dod chags kyis kun nas bslangs pa 'dod chags kyis rdzogs par byed pa lta bu'o,
english: The "rest"--which refers to the three of lying, divisive speech, and meaningless talk--are accepted as being completed by all three poisons of the mind. Such actions motivated by desire, for one example, would be brought to their completion by desire. 74 The Objects of Non-Virtue

acip: ,GZHI NI SEMS CAN LONGS SPYOD DANG , ,MING DANG GZUGS NI MING YIN NO,
wylie: gzhi ni sems can longs spyod dang , ,ming dang gzugs ni ming yin no
english: The objects consist of living beings, enjoyments. Names and forms, and then of names as well.

acip: [IV.283-4] 'O NA, CHA BZHI PO DE DAG GI GZHI GANG ZHE NA, CHA DANG PO'I GZHI NI SEMS CAN YIN TE, GSOD PA NI SEMS CAN GYI SROG GCOD PA DANG , GNOD SEMS SEMS CAN LA SDANG BA, TSIG RTZUB PO NI MI SNYAN PA, ZHES 'BYUNG BA'I PHYIR,
wylie: [iv.283-4] 'o na, cha bzhi po de dag gi gzhi gang zhe na, cha dang po'i gzhi ni sems can yin te, gsod pa ni sems can gyi srog gcod pa dang , gnod sems sems can la sdang ba, tshig rtsub po ni mi snyan pa, zhes 'byung ba'i phyir
english: One might ask what things serve as the objects for each of the four divisions of non-virtues just mentioned. The object of the non-virtues of the first division consists of living beings: killing is to take the life of a living being; malice is to feel hatred for a living being; and--as the root text itself says--"harsh speech is that which is unpleasant."

acip: CHA GNYIS PA'I GZHI NI LONGS SPYOD YIN TE, SEMS CAN GYI NANG GI REG BYA LA LONGS SPYOD PA LAS BYUNG BA DANG , DE LA BDAG TU BZUNG BA'I DBANG GIS BYUNG BA'I PHYIR,
wylie: cha gnyis pa'i gzhi ni longs spyod yin te, sems can gyi nang gi reg bya la longs spyod pa las byung ba dang , de la bdag tu bzung ba'i dbang gis byung ba'i phyir
english: The non-virtues of the second division have enjoyments as their object: they occur through enjoyment in the form of physical sensations within a living being, or by force of one's taking possession of certain enjoyments.

acip: CHA GSUM PA'I GZHI NI MING DANG GZUGS YIN TE, MING GZUGS KYIS BSDUS PA'I DGE MI DGE MED PAR LTA BA LAS BYUNG BA'I PHYIR, CHA BZHI PA'I GZHI NI MING YIN TE, RDZUN TSIG SOGS MING LA BRTEN NAS 'BYUNG BA'I PHYIR,
wylie: cha gsum pa'i gzhi ni ming dang gzugs yin te, ming gzugs kyis bsdus pa'i dge mi dge med par lta ba las byung ba'i phyir, cha bzhi pa'i gzhi ni ming yin te, rdzun tshig sogs ming la brten nas 'byung ba'i phyir
english: The objects of the third division are names and forms, for the non-virtue in this case arises from a view about the virtues and non-virtues that are all part of names and forms in general. The objects of the last division are names, for lying and so forth all occur--ultimately--based on the names of things. 75 Some Ethical Questions

acip: ,SNGA DANG MNYAM DU SHI BA LA, ,DNGOS MED LUS GZHAN SKYES PHYER RO, ,DMAG LA SOGS PAR DON GCIG PHYIR, ,THAMS CAD BYED PA PO BZHIN LDAN,
wylie: snga dang mnyam du shi ba la, ,dngos med lus gzhan skyes phyer ro, ,dmag la sogs par don gcig phyir, ,thams cad byed pa po bzhin ldan
english: There is no actual stage for those who die Before or together, for another body's been born. Because their goal's the same in a war or whatever, All possess it as much as the one who commits it.

acip: [IV.285-8] PHA ROL PO 'CHI NGES PA'I MTSAN BSNUN NAS, GSOD BYED DE GSAD BYA'I SNGAR SHI BA DANG , MNYAM DU SHI BA LA LAS LAM GYI DNGOS GZHI 'BYUNG NGAM MI 'BYUNG ZHE NA,
wylie: [iv.285-8] pha rol po 'chi nges pa'i mtshan bsnun nas, gsod byed de gsad bya'i sngar shi ba dang , mnyam du shi ba la las lam gyi dngos gzhi 'byung ngam mi 'byung zhe na
english: "Suppose," one may begin, "that a person takes a weapon and delivers a blow to someone else which is sure to kill him, but then this murderer himself happens to die, either before his victim or together with him--at the same time. Can we say then that the actual "commission" stage of a full path of action has occurred for such a murderer, or not?"

acip: DE LA DE 'BYUNG BA MED DE, GSAD BYA MA SHI BAR DE MI 'BYUNG , GSAD BYA DANG MNYAM DU SHI NA LUS GZHAN SKYES SHING , DES PHA ROL PO GSOD PA'I SBYOR BA MA BYAS PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: de la de 'byung ba med de, gsad bya ma shi bar de mi 'byung , gsad bya dang mnyam du shi na lus gzhan skyes shing , des pha rol po gsod pa'i sbyor ba ma byas pa'i phyir
english: The answer is that there is no occurrence of this stage for such a person. In the first place, the stage cannot occur before the victim dies; in the second place, where the murderer dies at the same time as his victim, another body of the killer has been born. There is no actual commission because the body never went through the stage of undertaking this act towards the victim in question.

acip: DMAG LA SOGS BA BYAS NAS GCIG GIS PHA ROL PO BSAD NA, GCIG PO DE KHO NA LA LAS LAM 'BYUNG NGAM ZHE NA, MA YIN TE, DMAG LA SOGS PAR GSOD PA'I DON GCIG LA ZHUGS PA'I PHYIR THAMS CAD GSOD PAR BYED PA PO BZHIN DU LAS LAM DANG LDAN PA YIN PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: dmag la sogs ba byas nas gcig gis pha rol po bsad na, gcig po de kho na la las lam 'byung ngam zhe na, ma yin te, dmag la sogs par gsod pa'i don gcig la zhugs pa'i phyir thams cad gsod par byed pa po bzhin du las lam dang ldan pa yin pa'i phyir
english: One may raise another question: "Suppose a group of people are engaged in a war or similar activity, and one of these people kills someone from the other side. Does a path of action occur only for the one person who actually did the killing?" It does not. Because they are engaged in the war (or whatever activity it may be) for the same common goal, all the people involved come to possess a full path of action, just as much as the one who commits it.

acip: GNYIS PA LA, RTZA BA BZHI, THA SNYAD BZHI, YAN LAG DRUG BSHAD PA'O,
wylie: gnyis pa la, rtsa ba bzhi, tha snyad bzhi, yan lag drug bshad pa'o
english: Next we present the definition of each individual non-virtue. We start with the "root" non-virtues, continue to the "four expressions," and end with the six "branch" non-virtues. 76 Definitions of the Four "Root" Non-Virtues

acip: ,SROG GCOD PA NI BSAMS BZHIN DU, ,MA NOR BAR NI GZHAN GSAD PA'O, ,MA BYIN LEN PA GZHAN GYI NOR, ,GTHU DANG 'JAB BUS BDAG GIR BYED, ,BGROD MIN 'GRO BA 'DOD PA YIS, ,LOG PAR G-YEM PA RNAM PA BZHI, ,RDZUN TSIG 'DU SHES GZHAN SGYUR BA'I, ,TSIG DON MNGON PAR GO BA'O,
wylie: srog gcod pa ni bsams bzhin du, ,ma nor bar ni gzhan gsad pa'o, ,ma byin len pa gzhan gyi nor, ,gthu dang 'jab bus bdag gir byed, ,bgrod min 'gro ba 'dod pa yis, ,log par g-yem pa rnam pa bzhi, ,rdzun tshig 'du shes gzhan sgyur ba'i, ,tshig don mngon par go ba'o
english: Taking life is killing another being Purposely, and without a mistake. Stealing is to take possession of Another's wealth by means of force or stealth. Sexual misconduct, of four types, Engaging in improper kinds of sex. Lying's when the meanings of one's words Are understood, a wrong impression given.

acip: [IV.289-96] ,DANG PO NI, MI DGE BA BCU SO SO'I NGO BO GANG ZHE NA, SROG GCOD PA NI BSAMS BZHIN DU MA NOR BAR NI GZHAN BSAD PA'O, , BSAMS BZHIN DU ZHES PAS MA BSAMS PAR SHI BA LA NYES PA MED PAR BSTAN,
wylie: [iv.289-96] ,dang po ni, mi dge ba bcu so so'i ngo bo gang zhe na, srog gcod pa ni bsams bzhin du ma nor bar ni gzhan bsad pa'o, , bsams bzhin du zhes pas ma bsams par shi ba la nyes pa med par bstan
english: "What," one may ask, "is the basic nature of each of the ten non-virtues?" The taking of life is defined as killing another being purposely, and without a mistake. The word "purposely" is meant to indicate that there is no problem like where the being in question has died but there was no intent.

acip: MA NOR BAR ZHES PAS LHA SBYIN LTA BU GSOD PA'I SBYOR BA BYAS NAS, GZHAN MCHOD SBYIN DANG NOR NAS MCHOD SBYIN BSAD KYANG LAS LAM GYI DNGOS GZHI MI 'BYUNG BAR BSTAN, GZHAN ZHES PAS RANG BSAD PA LA LAS LAM GYI DNGOS GZHI MI 'BYUNG BAR BSTAN TO,
wylie: ma nor bar zhes pas lha sbyin lta bu gsod pa'i sbyor ba byas nas, gzhan mchod sbyin dang nor nas mchod sbyin bsad kyang las lam gyi dngos gzhi mi 'byung bar bstan, gzhan zhes pas rang bsad pa la las lam gyi dngos gzhi mi 'byung bar bstan to
english: The words "without a mistake" are meant to indicate that no "actual- commission" stage of an act occurs in a case of mistaken identity; for example, in a case where you undertake to kill John but instead kill Joe because you have mistaken him for John. The word "another," finally, is meant to indicate that no "actual-commission" stage occurs either in an instance where one takes his own life.

acip: ,MA BYIN PAR LEN PA NI BSAMS BZHIN DU MA NOR BAR GZHAN GYI NOR MTHU DBANG CHA DANG 'JAB BUS MA TSOR BAR BDAG GIR BYED PA'O, , BSAMS BZHIN DU MA NOR PAR BGROD PAR BYA BA MIN PAR, 'GRO BAR 'DOD PA'I SGO NAS 'DOD PAS LOG PAR G-YEM PAR 'GYUR BA RNAM PA BZHI YOD DE,
wylie: ma byin par len pa ni bsams bzhin du ma nor bar gzhan gyi nor mthu dbang cha dang 'jab bus ma tshor bar bdag gir byed pa'o, , bsams bzhin du ma nor par bgrod par bya ba min par, 'gro bar 'dod pa'i sgo nas 'dod pas log par g-yem par 'gyur ba rnam pa bzhi yod de
english: Stealing is to take possession of another's wealth, purposely and without a mistake, whether it be by means of superior force or by stealth--undetected. Sexual misconduct is engaging in kinds of sex which are improper to perform, purposely and with no mistaken identity.
